WOODCHIP PRODUCTION A production for using wood chips to make six new products: Fire Logs, MDF Boards, OSB Boards, Smoker Pellets, and 3 types of wood mulch - Natural, Dark Brown, and Red. All products can be sold at any selling point. There is an area to unload logs and trees to be made into wood chips marked by a warning strip in front of the building with the trigger just inside the doors. At the back of the building, there is a loading pipe to take the wood chips out in bulk with a trailer.
Category: Productions Price: $55,000
Production Recipes (liters): - Fire Logs recipe - 100 Wood chips - 10 Diesel - 5 Water to 60 Fire logs with 25 cycles an hour
- MDF Board recipe - 100 Wood chips - 10 Water to 50 Mdf boards with 35 cycles an hour
- OSB Board recipe - 100 Wood chips - 10 Water to 65 Osb boards with 45 cycles an hour

- Smoker Pellets recipe - 100 Wood chips - 10 Water to 45 Smoker Pellets with 40 cycls an hour
- Wood Chips recipe - 1000 Wood to 1000 Wood Chips with 400 cycles an hour
GRAIN DRYER PACK Had a wet harvest? Need to dry your grain so you can sell it for a better price? Well look no further, this grain dryer pack is the answer. Simply input your grain (wheat,barley,oat,corn) and the fuel (wood, woodchip or methane and you are good to go! Methane can be purchased from the buypoint included in the pack, transported in the two tankers included in the pack or distributed from a BGA that supports methane to the grain drying shed! It can also be sold at the sell point provided in the pack. With a dedicated sell point you are guaranteed to get a significantly better profit on your grains!

THE BUTCHER BARN Creates Meats from Animals
OPEN AIR GARDEN These are 5 garden for growing vegetables and fruit outdoors. There is a small, a medium sized and a large garden. There are also two allotment gardens with a hut, tree, seating area and lots of decorations. One of them is kept more minimalist, with less decorations, to save slots.
All gardens come in four variants, each with and without a fence and with and without wooden garden beds. You can use a switch to raise a tarp greenhouse from the ground and then lower it again. You can also lower and raise the collisions for the fence using a switch.
In addition to the greenhouse plants from the base game, you can grow lots of other vegetables in these gardens. In addition to the standard recipes that only require water as an ingredient, there are also recipes with seeds and fertilizer. If you dump manure, it is automatically converted into fertilizer, so you can also fertilize the gardens with manure. These additional recipes result in more and faster plant growth. This means you get more profit than with the pure water recipes.
To water several gardens at once, there is a distributor that distributes the necessary ingredients to the gardens. There is also a small garden pump that provides free water.
